I wrote `component.html` in the folder, following `DESIGN.md`. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and look are unchecked.

The screen is a 1280px `#component` with the "New request" heading above a single form card. The card holds Title, Description, then Priority, Assignee and Due date side by side, with Cancel and Create Request at the bottom right. It's static HTML and CSS with no JavaScript.

- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't bundled, since the folder has no assets. The page names them first and falls back to the system sans-serif, so the heading will only look right if those fonts are installed.
- **Priority default:** Medium is preselected. You didn't specify a default, so tell me if you'd rather it start empty.
- **Heading case:** the heading is all caps through CSS (`text-transform: uppercase`), as `DESIGN.md` requires for page titles. The text in the HTML is still "New request".
